verses.text: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
O my God, I trust in thee: ב Bet Let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me. ג Gimel
Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: Let them be ashamed which transgress without cause. ד Dalet
Shew me thy ways, O LORD; Teach me thy paths. ה He
Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: (ו Waw) For thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day. ז Zain
Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; For they have been ever of old. ח Het
Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD. ט Tet
Good and upright is the LORD: Therefore will he teach sinners in the way. י Yod
The meek will he guide in judgment: And the meek will he teach his way. כ Kaph
All the paths of the LORDare mercy and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies. ל Lamed
For thy name's sake, O LORD, Pardon mine iniquity; for it is great. מ Mem
What man is he that feareth the LORD? Him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose. נ Nun
His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the earth. ס Samek
The secret of the LORDis with them that fear him; And he will shew them his covenant. ע Ain
Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; For he shall pluck my feet out of the net. פ Pe
Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted. צ Zade
The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses. (ק Qoph)
Look upon mine affliction and my pain; And forgive all my sins. ר Resh
Consider mine enemies; for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred. ש Shin
O keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee. ת Taw
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; For I wait on thee.
Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
